description: A still life painting in warm, dark oil style. A cream-coloured cloth flour sack tied at the top stands at left on a wooden table. Beside it is a yellow glazed bowl with a wooden spoon. In the centre is a round frosted cake on a white plate with a slice missing. At right is a tall stack of envelopes with handwritten addresses and stamps, with an ink bottle and dip pen in front. A dark wooden cabinet fills the background. No people are visible.
